mapper.select: /* file : MakeModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : getMakeModelTarget */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL A WHERE RESMPL_INTVL_TP IS NOT NULL AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND INDEX_TRGT_COL IS NOT NULL AND MODEL_STATUS = 'WAIT' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY MDFCN_DT ASC, MODEL_SEQ ASC LIMIT #{limitCnt}

/* file : MakeModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : setMakeModelParams */ SELECT *, (SELECT T.MODEL_ALGRM FROM TB_MODEL_ALGRM T WHERE T.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_ALGRM ,(SELECT T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM T WHERE T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM ,(SELECT T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM T WHERE T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP FROM TB_MODEL_PARAMS A WHERE A.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
